page_title: FRE 1-0 WER | Freiburg v Werder Bremen 26/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Niclas Fullkrug (Werder Bremen) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar.

90+6' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) shows off his superb ability as he volleys the ball from inside the box into the bottom right corner. The assist goes to Noah Weisshaupt and the score changes to 1:0.
90+1' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Freiburg.
90+1' What a chance! Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) rises high to connect with the resulting corner inside the box, but his bullet header rattles the right post.
90+1' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee points to the corner flag and Freiburg will take a corner.
87' That's the end of the game for Romano Schmid, who is replaced by Ilia Gruev (Werder Bremen).
87' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) replaces Marvin Ducksch.
84' Here's the change. Lukas Kubler leaves the pitch and Kenneth Schmidt (Freiburg) comes on as a substitute.
84' Substitution. Lucas Holer is replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
81' The game is interrupted now, Lucas Holer (Freiburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
79' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Christian Gross and he is replaced by Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen).
76' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
76' Corner kick. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is ready to send the ball into the box.

76' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Freiburg manage to earn a corner.
74' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
72' Niclas Fullkrug (Werder Bremen) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
71' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) replacing Mitchell Weiser.
71' Here comes a substitution. Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is brought on as a substitute for Ritsu Doan.
68' CHANCE! Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) fires just wide of the left post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Lucas Holer.
67' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
67' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
65' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) does well to meet the corner from Marvin Ducksch, but his close-range header is soft and goes miles wide of the right post.
65' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

64' The ball from the resulting corner kick slipped through the box to Niclas Fullkrug (Werder Bremen), who instantly fires a low shot towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is blocked. So unlucky.
64' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
63' The corner kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Roland Sallai leaves the pitch and Maximilian Philipp (Freiburg) comes on.

61' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him. The rebound finds Roland Sallai (Freiburg) in space inside the box, but his shot goes well wide of the right post. That was a promising chance!
57' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the left side of the target, but Jiri Pavlenka easily deals with the threat.
55' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Benjamin Brand and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
53' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) reacts quickest to a cross from Kiliann Sildillia, but slams his header well wide of the left post from around the penalty spot.
53' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
51' Close! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is a whisker away from finishing-off the move he started. His close-range effort flies just over the bar.
50' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) brings his opponent down. Benjamin Brand has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Benjamin Brand has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+1' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) lines up the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but he produces a poor shot that goes high over the bar. The ball could have snow on it when it returns!
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) was quite harsh and Benjamin Brand didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
44' Ritsu Doan (Freiburg) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
43' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
41' Niclas Fullkrug (Werder Bremen) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
39' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
38' Yellow card. Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

35' Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. A rebound falls at the feet of Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
31' That's unlucky! Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
30' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benjamin Brand who sees an offensive foul.
30' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:4. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
25' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) steps up to send the ball in.

24' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) gets to a rebound inside the penalty area, controls it with a nice touch and shoots towards the left post. However, the excellent Jiri Pavlenka makes a save and thwarts the great opportunity. Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the left side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Jiri Pavlenka.
23' Niclas Fullkrug (Werder Bremen) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
20' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Jiri Pavlenka.
18' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!

17' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
16' A dangerous looking corner kick from Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is cleared to safety by the defence.

16' It could have been a good chance to score! Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) fails to release Niclas Fullkrug with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears. Werder Bremen force their opponents to concede a corner.
15' Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) tries to find Lucas Holer, but he puts too much power on the pass.
13' Some great controlled play and passing from Werder Bremen. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Niclas Fullkrug (Werder Bremen) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
6' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is given a yellow card.
5' Vincenzo Grifo swings the cross over. Lucas Holer (Freiburg) gets his head to it but it goes just over the crossbar.
5' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
3' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
2' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) offside.
1' One of the players from Werder Bremen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Freiburg will have the kick-off.
Benjamin Brand got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
